parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The name of the main streaming domain.

parameters.name: RemoveFile
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to delete the corresponding file in Object Storage Service (OSS) synchronously. Valid values:

*   **true**: The corresponding file in OSS is deleted.
*   **false**: The corresponding file in OSS is not deleted.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-stream-record-index-files --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --record-id c4d7f0a4-b506-43f9-8de3-07732c3f0000 --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --remove-file true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveStreamRecordIndexFiles --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --RecordId.1 'c4d7f0a4-b506-43f9-8de3-07732c3f0000' --RemoveFile true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
